scope: Separate interpretation supplement; initial audits/raw captures retained unchanged. Original observation interval only.
source_verification: Current official metric semantics checked by parent; this offline auditor makes no network request.

counter_analysis.interpretation: A positive cumulative counter alone does not show new throttling. Positive deltas with both samples inside the observation prove increases during that sampled interval. Boundary-crossing increases cannot be assigned wholly to the observation. Decreases may indicate a reset; positive deltas are reported separately and are not an exact reset-corrected total. Fifteen-second samples can miss resets and do not localize request causality.

initial_positive_throttle_flag_interpret: cpu-window-proof.sampled_throttle_observed records positive counter samples; use the counter-delta field here to identify newly observed throttling.
